subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked with a merge base, docgate shall fail a diff that adds more than one PRD ledger entry — an added `NNN-<slug>.md` file one directory below the configured PRDs root — naming each added entry and the remedy; the generated projection, the flat placeholder corpus (NG-1), and modifications of existing entries (already fenced by FR-4) do not count.
rationale: one concern per PR becomes code for the ledger: one amendment, or one new base, per change keeps concurrent claims content-free and reviews honest
fit_criterion: temp-repo fixtures: a diff adding two entries (one ledger or two) → red naming both and the remedy; a diff adding exactly one amendment → green; a new PRD's lone `000-base.md` → green; a projection-only regeneration with no added entry → green; a flat placeholder is never counted
